name: aqualims
description: Aqua LIMS - aquarium water quality LIMS (MERN rebuild of the XAF AquaLIMS app)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n db,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run db" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p client --noEmit && tsc -p scripts --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace shared && npm run test --workspace server
